title: Caretaker Relay
bodyText:
Caretaker Relay

Shared care, verified

Care service warm

Care continuity

Create an account or sign in. Access to someone’s care requires an invitation or approval — not a role selection alone.

Sign in
Return to care you already have access to
Create account
Create a private account with no care access

SECURE PATHS

Accept invitation
Use a secure invitation from an authorized person
Set up care for someone new
Create a new provisional care profile

Care service is ready.

Lab demo sign-in uses seeded principals. Create account never opens an existing care record. “Someone new” never searches for people already in the system.
